'''Margaret M. Wiecek''' (also known as '''Małgorzata M. Więcek''') is a Polish-American [[operations research]]er and professor of mathematical sciences at [[Clemson University]], known for her research in [[multi-objective optimization]], [[Pareto efficiency]], [[Taguchi methods|robust design]],{{r|medal}} and three-dimensional [[packing problems]] in [[mechanical engineering]].{{r|pack}}

Wiecek earned her Ph.D. from the [[AGH University of Science and Technology|Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza]] in [[Kraków]], Poland, in 1984, under the supervision of Henryk Górecki.{{r|mgp}} She joined the Clemson faculty in 1988.{{r|medal}}

Wiecek was president of the [[INFORMS]] section on Multiple Criteria Decision Making for 2016–2017.{{r|clemfac}} In 2019, the International Society on Multiple Criteria Decision Making gave Wiecek their highest award, the Multiple Criteria Decision Making Gold Medal.{{r|medal}}
